  • Constructor Details

    • Result

      private Result(List<EmulsionSeparationStudy.ProfilePoint> points, double initialVolume, double incomingVolume, double accumulatedVolume, double coalescedVolume, double criticalFlow, double steadyHeight, EmulsionSeparationStudy.KineticsProvenance provenance, List<String> findings, List<EmulsionSeparationStudy.Scenario> sensitivityScenarios)
      Store a detached nominal result and declared scenarios.
      Parameters:
      points - nominal time profile
      initialVolume - initial dispersed-water volume in m3
      incomingVolume - integrated incoming dispersed-water volume in m3
      accumulatedVolume - final dispersed-water volume in m3
      coalescedVolume - integrated coalesced-water volume in m3
      criticalFlow - critical incoming dispersed-water flow in m3/s
      steadyHeight - steady layer height in m, or positive infinity
      provenance - kinetic-input provenance
      findings - applicability and uncertainty findings
      sensitivityScenarios - nominal and optional assumed sensitivity scenarios
